title: run/5 docstring still claims production passes now_iso:"" — W1 fix left it stale
detail: W1 fixed bootstrap() to pass now_iso() (a real stamp), but run/5's docstring still claims production passes "". Maintainers read the comment, not the call sites — misleading.
recommended_fix: Rewrite run/5's docstring to 'production passes now_iso(); "" defers to Postgres now() only when a caller chooses'.

title: AttemptEntry JSONB decoder duplicated in sweep.gleam and result.gleam (N6 still open)
evidence:
sweep.gleam:814  fn attempt_decoder() -> decode.Decoder(AttemptEntry) { use at <- decode.optional_field("at", "", decode.string) ... }
result.gleam:508  fn attempt_decoder() -> decode.Decoder(AttemptRow) { ... }
detail: Two copies of the same {at,channel,outcome,detail} decoder for one JSONB shape; a schema change must be edited in both. Untouched by the r2 delta.
recommended_fix: Hoist one attempt decoder into messages.gleam (next to AttemptEntry) and import it from both modules.

title: standard_sender const duplicated verbatim in send.gleam and notification_dispatch.gleam (N7 still open)
evidence:
send.gleam:34                  const standard_sender: String = "RightTenantry <noreply@app.righttenantry.ie>"
notification_dispatch.gleam:18 const standard_sender: String = "RightTenantry <noreply@app.righttenantry.ie>"
detail: Identical sender string defined in two modules; a sender-address change must be edited in both. Untouched by the r2 delta (the new dispatch_warm_handoff call goes through notify_reference_unreachable).

title: sweep.gleam re-implements messages.first_name without the trim (N8 still open)
evidence:
sweep.gleam:748  fn first_name(full: String) -> String { case string.split(full, " ") { [first, ..] -> first; _ -> full } }   // no trim
messages.gleam:139 pub fn first_name(name name: String) -> String { case string.split(string.trim(name), " ") { [first, ..] -> first; [] -> name } }
detail: Local copy skips string.trim, so leading whitespace yields an empty first token; messages.first_name is public. Untouched by the r2 delta (new outcomes_to_entries uses channel_name/outcome_name, not first_name).
recommended_fix: Call messages.first_name from sweep.gleam and delete the local copy.
